This template is to be used for citing individual stories published within issues of the [[2017]] [[Star Wars Adventures (2017)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] anthology [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] by [[IDW Publishing]].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, paste it into the appropriate place in an article, and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=|annual=|story=|stext=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*One of the two following:
**'''issue''': Number of the issue being cited.
**'''annual''': Year of the annual.
*'''story''': Wikilinked name of the story being cited.

===Optional parameters===
*'''stext''': Formatted name of the story being cited.

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=1|story=Better the Devil You Know, Part I}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=1|story=Better the Devil You Know, Part I}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>
{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=32|story=The Battle for Horizon Base}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=32|story=The Battle for Horizon Base}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|annual=2018|story=Mind Your Manners}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|annual=2018|story=Mind Your Manners}}

==See also==
For pages relating to the [[2020]] ''[[Star Wars Adventures (2020)|Star Wars Adventures]]'' series, use {{Tl|IDWAdventuresCite-2020}}.
